---
title: "Adoption Risk by Region"
subtitle: "Customers rated Black or Red on product adoption, and every customer in lifecycle Stage 1"
date: "`r format(Sys.Date(), '%B %d, %Y')`"
output:
  pdf_document:
    latex_engine: xelatex
    toc: false
    number_sections: false
    fig_caption: false
geometry: "landscape, margin=0.6in"
fontsize: 10pt
# Symbols the default LaTeX font lacks (same as inst/guide/immuta_accounts_guide.Rmd).
header-includes:
  - \usepackage{newunicodechar}
  - \newunicodechar{−}{\ensuremath{-}}
  - \newunicodechar{≥}{\ensuremath{\geq}}
  - \usepackage{xcolor}
  - \usepackage{longtable,booktabs,array}
params:
  snapshot: ''
  # Ratings to include (the colour word that starts product_adoption_rating).
  colours: ["black", "red"]
---

<!-- Printable list of every customer whose product adoption rating
     (op_list$accounts$product_adoption_rating, op_list_product_adoption()) is
     Black or Red, one page per region. Knit from RStudio or
     rmarkdown::render("reports/adoption_risk_by_region.Rmd").
     Needs a LaTeX install with xelatex (tinytex::install_tinytex()). -->

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
# Knit from reports/; everything below runs from the project root.
root <- normalizePath("..")
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
                      fig.width = 9.5, fig.height = 3.2, fig.align = "center")
devtools::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Text and table values: "$" escaped so pandoc never reads a pair of them as maths.
usd  <- function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), "—", paste0("\\", scales::dollar(round(x))))
usdk <- function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), "—", paste0("\\", ifelse(abs(x) >= 1e6,
                    paste0("$", formatC(x / 1e6, format = "f", digits = 2), "M"), paste0("$", round(x / 1e3), "K"))))
pct  <- function(x, d = 0) ifelse(is.na(x), "—", paste0(formatC(100 * x, format = "f", digits = d), "%"))
num  <- function(x) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
key  <- function(x) tolower(trimws(as.character(x)))
cell <- function(x) { x <- as.character(x); x[is.na(x) | !nzchar(trimws(x))] <- "—"; gsub("|", "/", x, fixed = TRUE) }

rating_colour <- function(x) {
  x <- key(x)
  out <- ifelse(grepl("^(green|amber|yellow|red|black)", x), sub("^(green|amber|yellow|red|black).*$", "\\1", x), NA)
  ifelse(out == "yellow", "amber", out)
}
HEX <- c(black = "111111", red = "DC2626", amber = "F59E0B", green = "16A34A")
# A coloured square for the rating, in LaTeX.
swatch <- function(col) ifelse(col %in% names(HEX), sprintf("\\textcolor[HTML]{%s}{\\rule{1.3ex}{1.3ex}}", HEX[col]), "")
# Escape text for LaTeX (account names carry &, #, % and the like).
tex <- function(x) {
  x <- cell(x)
  x <- gsub("\\", "\001", x, fixed = TRUE)            # protect backslashes until the end
  x <- gsub("([&%$#_{}])", "\\\\\\1", x)
  x <- gsub("~", "\\textasciitilde{}", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("^", "\\textasciicircum{}", x, fixed = TRUE)
  gsub("\001", "\\textbackslash{}", x, fixed = TRUE)
}
# The region tables are LaTeX longtables rather than pipe tables: fixed column
# widths keep the numbers from overlapping on a landscape page, and the header
# repeats if a region runs onto a second page.
REGION_COLS <- c(
  Account = ">{\\raggedright\\arraybackslash}p{1.65in}", Rating = ">{\\raggedright\\arraybackslash}p{1.3in}",
  Score = "r", "Seats\\\\used" = "r", ARR = "r", CSM = ">{\\raggedright\\arraybackslash}p{1.05in}", Stage = "l",
  "Customer\\\\for" = "r", "Next renewal" = ">{\\raggedright\\arraybackslash}p{1.1in}",
  "Renewal\\\\amount" = "r", "Account risk" = ">{\\raggedright\\arraybackslash}p{1.2in}")
# Stage 1 page: every row is S1, so Region replaces Stage; Score is dropped to keep the width.
S1_COLS <- c(
  Account = ">{\\raggedright\\arraybackslash}p{1.55in}", Region = ">{\\raggedright\\arraybackslash}p{0.8in}",
  Rating = ">{\\raggedright\\arraybackslash}p{1.3in}", "Seats\\\\used" = "r", ARR = "r",
  CSM = ">{\\raggedright\\arraybackslash}p{1.05in}", "Customer\\\\for" = "r",
  "Next renewal" = ">{\\raggedright\\arraybackslash}p{1.1in}", "Renewal\\\\amount" = "r",
  "Account risk" = ">{\\raggedright\\arraybackslash}p{1.2in}")
latex_table <- function(cells, cols = REGION_COLS) {
  hdr <- vapply(names(cols), function(h)
    if (grepl("\\\\", h, fixed = TRUE)) sprintf("\\textbf{\\shortstack[l]{%s}}", h) else sprintf("\\textbf{%s}", h), "")
  body <- apply(cells, 1, function(r) paste0(paste(r, collapse = " & "), " \\\\"))
  paste0("\\begingroup\\small\\setlength{\\tabcolsep}{4pt}\n",
         "\\begin{longtable}{@{}", paste(cols, collapse = ""), "@{}}\n\\toprule\n",
         paste(hdr, collapse = " & "), " \\\\\n\\midrule\n\\endhead\n",
         paste(body, collapse = "\n"), "\n\\bottomrule\n\\end{longtable}\n\\endgroup\n")
}
# "Black: Critical Churn Risk" -> "Critical churn risk"; "Red: High Risk - Adoption" -> "High risk – adoption"
rating_label <- function(x) {
  l <- trimws(sub("^(green|amber|yellow|red|black)\\s*[:\\-–—]*\\s*", "", x, ignore.case = TRUE, perl = TRUE))
  l <- gsub("\\s+-\\s+", " – ", l, perl = TRUE)
  paste0(toupper(substr(l, 1, 1)), tolower(substring(l, 2)))
}

theme_set(theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
            theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), legend.position = "bottom",
                  plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")))
```

```{r data}
snap <- if (nzchar(params$snapshot)) file.path(root, params$snapshot) else {
  f <- list.files(file.path(root, "data"), pattern = "^opportunities_\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}\\.RData$",
                  full.names = TRUE)
  f[order(f, decreasing = TRUE)][1]
}
load(snap)   # -> op_list
snap_date <- sub("^opportunities_(.*)\\.RData$", "\\1", basename(snap))

acc <- op_list$accounts
col_or_na <- function(df, nm) if (nm %in% names(df)) df[[nm]] else rep(NA, nrow(df))
book <- data.frame(
  account   = acc$`Account Name`,
  region    = ifelse(is.na(acc$Region) | !nzchar(trimws(acc$Region)), "No region", trimws(acc$Region)),
  csm       = col_or_na(acc, "Customer Success Manager"),
  arr       = num(acc$`Contract ARR Rollup`),
  rating    = col_or_na(acc, "product_adoption_rating"),
  score     = num(col_or_na(acc, "product_adoption")),
  lifecycle = col_or_na(acc, "Lifecycle Stage"),
  months    = num(col_or_na(acc, "months_as_customer")),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
book$colour <- rating_colour(book$rating)

# Seats used (registered / licensed; ELA = 100%), from consumption$low_consumption.
lc <- op_list$consumption$low_consumption
m  <- match(key(book$account), key(lc$`Account Name`))
book$ratio <- if (is.null(lc)) NA_real_ else consumption_ratio(num(lc$`Registered Users`)[m], num(lc$`Licensed Users`)[m])

# Next renewal: the earliest open contract end, its quarter, amount and risk.
ren <- op_list$renewals
ren$end <- as.Date(ren$`Current Contract End Date`)
nr <- ren %>% filter(!is.na(end)) %>% group_by(k = key(`Account Name`)) %>% filter(end == min(end)) %>%
  summarise(end = min(end), amt = sum(num(Amount), na.rm = TRUE),
            risk = paste(unique(stats::na.omit(`Account Risk`)), collapse = ", "), .groups = "drop")
i <- match(key(book$account), nr$k)
book$renewal_end <- nr$end[i]
book$renewal_amt <- nr$amt[i]
book$renewal_risk <- nr$risk[i]

risk <- book %>% filter(colour %in% params$colours) %>%
  mutate(colour = factor(colour, levels = params$colours)) %>%
  arrange(region, colour, desc(arr))
regions <- sort(unique(risk$region))

# Lifecycle Stage 1 ("S1: Installation and Config."), any rating. Matched like the
# dashboard's CS Coverage tab (covIsOnboarding()): "S1", "install" or "onboard".
s1 <- book %>% filter(grepl("^\\s*S1\\b|install|onboard", lifecycle, ignore.case = TRUE)) %>%
  arrange(region, desc(months), desc(arr))
region_arr <- book %>% group_by(region) %>% summarise(book_arr = sum(arr, na.rm = TRUE), book_n = n(), .groups = "drop")
```

# Summary

**`r nrow(risk)` of `r nrow(book)` customers** are rated
`r paste(tools::toTitleCase(params$colours), collapse = " or ")` on product adoption, carrying
**`r usd(sum(risk$arr, na.rm = TRUE))`** of contract ARR
(`r pct(sum(risk$arr, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(book$arr, na.rm = TRUE))` of the book). Each region has its
own page with every account, Black first, then by ARR. The page after this one lists the
`r nrow(s1)` customers still in lifecycle Stage 1 (Installation and Config.), whatever their rating.

```{r summary-table}
by_r <- risk %>% group_by(Region = region) %>%
  summarise(n_black = sum(colour == "black"), arr_black = sum(arr[colour == "black"], na.rm = TRUE),
            n_red = sum(colour == "red"), arr_red = sum(arr[colour == "red"], na.rm = TRUE),
            n = n(), arr = sum(arr, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(region_arr, by = c("Region" = "region")) %>% arrange(desc(arr))
tot <- by_r %>% summarise(Region = "**Total**", across(c(n_black, arr_black, n_red, arr_red, n, arr, book_arr, book_n), sum))
tot$book_arr <- sum(book$arr, na.rm = TRUE); tot$book_n <- nrow(book)   # whole book, not just regions at risk
st <- bind_rows(by_r, tot) %>% transmute(
  Region,
  `Black: accounts` = n_black, `Black: ARR` = usd(arr_black),
  `Red: accounts` = n_red, `Red: ARR` = usd(arr_red),
  `At-risk accounts` = paste0(n, " of ", book_n), `At-risk ARR` = usd(arr),
  `Share of region ARR` = pct(arr / book_arr))
knitr::kable(st, format = "pipe", align = c("l", rep("r", 7)))
```

```{r summary-chart}
ch <- risk %>% group_by(region, colour) %>% summarise(arr = sum(arr, na.rm = TRUE), n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(region = factor(region, levels = rev(by_r$Region)))
ggplot(ch, aes(arr, region, fill = colour)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(black = "#111111", red = "#DC2626"),
                    labels = c(black = "Black: critical churn risk", red = "Red: high risk"), name = NULL) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::label_dollar(scale_cut = scales::cut_short_scale())) +
  labs(x = "Contract ARR at adoption risk", y = NULL)
```

\footnotesize

**Ratings.** `product_adoption_rating` crosses the product adoption score (PBAC complexity + Request + Comply
points, 0–12) with seats used (registered ÷ licensed users; an ELA counts as 100%). **Black: Critical Churn
Risk** is low adoption on low consumption; **Red: High Risk – Adoption** is low adoption despite consumption;
**Red: High Risk – Consumption** is real adoption on few seats. Data: op_list snapshot `r snap_date`.

\normalsize

```{r stage1, results = "asis"}
cat("\n\\newpage\n\n# Stage 1: Installation and Config.\n\n")
if (!nrow(s1)) {
  cat("No customers are in lifecycle Stage 1.\n\n")
} else {
  rc <- table(factor(ifelse(is.na(s1$colour), "unrated", as.character(s1$colour)),
                     levels = c("black", "red", "amber", "green", "unrated")))
  rc <- rc[rc > 0]
  cat(sprintf("**%d customers in Stage 1, %s ARR** (%s of the book): %s. Ordered by region, then longest a customer first.\n\n",
              nrow(s1), usd(sum(s1$arr, na.rm = TRUE)), pct(sum(s1$arr, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(book$arr, na.rm = TRUE)),
              paste0(rc, " ", tools::toTitleCase(names(rc)), collapse = ", ")))
  cells <- cbind(
    tex(s1$account),
    tex(s1$region),
    paste(swatch(s1$colour), tex(ifelse(is.na(s1$rating), "—", rating_label(s1$rating)))),
    gsub("%", "\\%", pct(s1$ratio), fixed = TRUE),
    usd(s1$arr),
    tex(s1$csm),
    ifelse(is.na(s1$months), "—", paste0(s1$months, " mo")),
    ifelse(is.na(s1$renewal_end), "—",
           paste0(format(s1$renewal_end, "%b %d, %Y"), " (", date_to_fiscal_quarter(s1$renewal_end), ")")),
    ifelse(is.na(s1$renewal_end), "—", usd(s1$renewal_amt)),
    tex(s1$renewal_risk))
  cat(latex_table(cells, S1_COLS))
  cat("\n\\footnotesize\n\n*Customer for* is months since the earliest contract start (report 00OVV000007MTSL2A4), or Vitally's Days as Customer where that is longer: the contract report currently returns only the current term (accounts\\$tenure\\_source says which source was used).\n\n\\normalsize\n")
}
```

```{r regions, results = "asis"}
for (rg in regions) {
  d <- risk[risk$region == rg, ]
  ra <- region_arr$book_arr[region_arr$region == rg]
  cat("\n\\newpage\n\n# ", rg, "\n\n", sep = "")
  cat(sprintf("**%d at-risk accounts, %s ARR** (%s of %s's %s): %d Black (%s), %d Red (%s).\n\n",
              nrow(d), usd(sum(d$arr, na.rm = TRUE)), pct(sum(d$arr, na.rm = TRUE) / ra), rg, usdk(ra),
              sum(d$colour == "black"), usd(sum(d$arr[d$colour == "black"], na.rm = TRUE)),
              sum(d$colour == "red"), usd(sum(d$arr[d$colour == "red"], na.rm = TRUE))))
  cells <- cbind(
    tex(d$account),
    paste(swatch(as.character(d$colour)), tex(rating_label(d$rating))),
    ifelse(is.na(d$score), "—", d$score),
    gsub("%", "\\%", pct(d$ratio), fixed = TRUE),
    usd(d$arr),                                   # already "\$1,234" (valid LaTeX)
    tex(d$csm),
    tex(sub("^(S\\d).*$", "\\1", d$lifecycle)),
    ifelse(is.na(d$months), "—", paste0(d$months, " mo")),
    ifelse(is.na(d$renewal_end), "—",
           paste0(format(d$renewal_end, "%b %d, %Y"), " (", date_to_fiscal_quarter(d$renewal_end), ")")),
    ifelse(is.na(d$renewal_end), "—", usd(d$renewal_amt)),
    tex(d$renewal_risk))
  cat(latex_table(cells))
  cat("\n")
}
```
